Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.transaction

Interface AIiExecutionTransaction

All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionSchedulingScope, eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionDependencyTarget, eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionIdentifiable, eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionScope, AIiTransactionScope
public interface AIiExecutionTransaction extends AIiTransactionScope, eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionDependencyTarget
Independent top-level transaction owning final commit, rollback and journal. The transaction is a scope for multiple concurrently executing actions, not a thread. Execution dependencies across top-level transactions do not merge rollback fates.
